name: messenger
description: ⚡ Веб-мессенджер в реальном времени: React + Node.js + Socket.IO

scripts.setup: npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm install --prefix server --no-audit --no-fund && npm install --prefix client --no-audit --no-fund
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
